section: Perspectives in Education · Ch18 — NCF 2005: Five Guiding Principles
subject: Perspectives in Education
stem: One of NCF 2005's five guiding principles calls for education to nurture in children an identity informed by which broad value?

options.option_text: Caring concerns within the framework of India's democratic polity
Rote conformity to a single prescribed textbook
Complete indifference to civic or social values

explanation: NCF 2005's fifth guiding principle is often the least remembered: nurturing an over-riding identity informed by caring concerns within the democratic polity of the country — linking education to democratic and civic values, not just academic content.

section: Perspectives in Education · Ch18 — NCF 2005: Five Guiding Principles
subject: Perspectives in Education
stem: NCF 2005's guiding principle of 'enriching the curriculum' specifically calls for moving away from:

options.option_text: A narrow, textbook-centric approach, toward providing for the overall development of children
Any use of textbooks whatsoever, in any form
Teaching any academic subjects at all

explanation: This principle calls for the curriculum to enrich all-round development (co-curricular, life skills, values), not just deliver textbook content — it does not mean abandoning textbooks entirely, only reducing over-reliance on them as the sole source of learning.

section: Perspectives in Education · Ch18 — NCF 2005: Five Guiding Principles
subject: Perspectives in Education
stem: Which of the following is NOT one of NCF 2005's five guiding principles?

options.option_text: Strict streaming of students into fixed ability groups from Class 1 onward
Connecting knowledge to life outside the school
Ensuring learning shifts away from rote methods
Making examinations more flexible and integrated with classroom life

explanation: Strict ability-based streaming from an early age is NOT among NCF 2005's five principles — in fact it runs counter to NCF's inclusive, child-centred philosophy. The other three options are genuine NCF 2005 guiding principles.
